title: Unaffected coordinates in clause filling
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let two finite lists of literals on the $n$ coordinates and an assignment of signs to those coordinates be given, and let $i$ be a coordinate that does not occur among the indices of the auxiliary literals. Then the assignment produced by the recursive clause-filling operation has at $i$ the same sign as the original assignment.
hypotheses_covered: Two lists of literals on $n$ coordinates
An assignment of signs to the $n$ coordinates
The coordinate $i$ is absent from the list of auxiliary-literal indices
